class RecordingSpanExporter(SpanExporter):
    def __init__(self):
        self.exported_spans = []

    def export(self, spans):
        self.exported_spans.extend(spans)
        return SpanExportResult.SUCCESS

    def shutdown(self):

        flush_at=1,
